items.title: The fake news game: actively inoculating against the risk of misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: we developed a ‘fake news game’ in which participants are actively tasked with creating a news article about a strongly politicized issue (the European refugee crisis) using misleading tactics
judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted a randomized field study (N = 95) in a public high school setting.
judge.reason: The article describes an empirical study (randomized field study) evaluating an inoculation game (the 'fake news game') on a relevant topic (misinformation). The study design and findings are consistent with the researcher's requirements.

items.title: Fake news game confers psychological resistance against online misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In a novel attempt to address this issue, we designed a psychological intervention in the form of an online browser game. In the game, players take on the role of a fake news producer and learn to master six documented techniques commonly used in the production of misinformation
judge.evidence_empirical: We conducted a large-scale evaluation of the game with N = 15,000 participants in a pre-post gameplay design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) e um estudo empírico pré-pós com 15.000 participantes, o que está em total conformidade com o pedido do pesquisador.

items.title: Good News about Bad News: Gamified Inoculation Boosts Confidence and Cognitive Immunity Against Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: We present a replication and extension into the effectiveness of Bad News as an anti-misinformation intervention.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a 2 (treatment vs. control) × 2 (pre vs. post) mixed design (N = 196) we measure participants’ ability to spot misinformation techniques in 18 fake headlines before and after playing Bad News.
judge.reason: O artigo avalia o jogo Bad News, que é explicitamente citado como exemplo permitido no pedido. O estudo é empírico (experimento com delineamento misto), não aborda os temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária) e os dados extraídos refletem corretamente o método e os resultados apresentados no resumo.

items.title: Prebunking interventions based on the psychological theory of “inoculation” can reduce susceptibility to misinformation across cultures
Disentangling Item and Testing Effects in Inoculation Research on Online Misinformation: Solomon Revisited

judge.evidence_topic: This study addresses two unanswered methodological questions about a widely adopted online “fake news” inoculation game, Bad News.
judge.evidence_empirical: We investigate both item and testing effects in two online studies (total N = 2,159) using the Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News, que é um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, atendendo ao tema. O estudo é empírico (dois estudos online) e utiliza um delineamento experimental (Solomon's Three Group Design), o que é adequado. O achado principal extraído reflete fielmente o que está escrito no resumo.

items.title: Long-term effectiveness of inoculation against misinformation: Three longitudinal experiments

judge.evidence_topic: we tested the effectiveness of Bad News, a real-world intervention in which participants develop resistance against misinformation through exposure to weakened doses of misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using 3 longitudinal experiments (2 preregistered), we tested the effectiveness of Bad News... In 3 experiments (NExp1 = 151, NExp2 = 194, NExp3 = 170), participants played either Bad News (inoculation group) or Tetris (gamified control group)
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (três experimentos) sobre o jogo Bad News, que é uma intervenção de inoculação contra desinformação. O estudo não foca nos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária). Os achados sobre a eficácia da inoculação e sua longevidade são sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Technique-based inoculation against real-world misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments
judge.reason: O artigo descreve dois experimentos utilizando o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra técnicas de desinformação. O tamanho da amostra e os achados estão corretamente refletidos nos dados extraídos. O estudo não se concentra nos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições).

items.title: Feedback exercises boost discernment of misinformation for gamified inoculation interventions

judge.evidence_topic: Gamification is a promising approach to reducing misinformation susceptibility. Previous research has found that 'inoculation' games such as Bad News and Harmony Square help build cognitive resistance against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We address these issues in two preregistered lab experiments (N1 = 191, N2 = 321) and four quasi-experimental in-game surveys implemented in Harmony Square (N3 = 559) and Bad News (N4 = 2,558, N5 = 419, N6 = 882).
judge.reason: O artigo aborda jogos de inoculação (Bad News e Harmony Square) contra desinformação, utilizando métodos empíricos (experimentos e quase-experimentos) sem tratar dos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições). Os dados extraídos sobre o método e os achados estão em total conformidade com o resumo.

items.title: Bad News in the civics classroom: How serious gameplay fosters teenagers' ability to discern misinformation techniques

judge.evidence_topic: Although the serious game Bad News has been used to inoculate citizens against misinformation... evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students... Results show that students improved their ability to discern manipulation techniques in social media posts.
judge.evidence_empirical: We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students playing individually, paired, or with the whole class.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) em contexto educacional, sem abordar os temas excluídos. O estudo é empírico e o método descrito no resumo (pré e pós-intervenção) condiz com o extraído. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Game-based inoculation versus graphic-based inoculation to combat misinformation: a randomized controlled trial

judge.evidence_topic: This study employed inoculation theory and developed an interactive game to help the public counter misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 180 Chinese participants were randomly assigned to game-based inoculation, graphic-based inoculation, and control groups.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um ensaio controlado randomizado (RCT) que avalia um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, sem focar nos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária). Os dados extraídos sobre o método e o achado principal estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: How to “inoculate” against multimodal misinformation: A conceptual replication of Roozenbeek and van der Linden (2020)

judge.evidence_topic: We developed a game called Cat Park , in which players learn about five manipulation techniques (trolling, emotional manipulation, amplification, polarization, and conspiracism), and how misinformation can spread through images.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game’s efficacy, we conducted a conceptual replication ( N = 380) of Roozenbeek and van der Linden’s 2020 study about Harmony Square , with the same study design, item set, and hypotheses.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (experimento) sobre um jogo de inoculação (Cat Park) contra desinformação, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. Os achados extraídos estão totalmente sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Mixed News about the Bad News Game

judge.evidence_topic: Basol et al. (2020) tested the “the Bad News Game” (BNG), an app designed to improve ability to spot false claims on social media.
judge.evidence_empirical: Here, four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al., using updated versions of the original Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (replicação) sobre o jogo Bad News, que se enquadra no tema de jogos de inoculação contra desinformação. O método descrito (experimento com pré e pós-teste) é compatível com o resumo. O achado principal está totalmente sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of this study is to address this gap by examining whether pre-service teachers can learn about fake news using the augmented reality escape game Escape Fake.
judge.evidence_empirical: To investigate this question, a pre-/post-test design was conducted with 45 pre-service teachers
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré/pós-teste) utilizando um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) para ensinar sobre fake news, o que está alinhado com o pedido. O achado extraído reflete precisamente os resultados relatados no resumo.

items.title: Playing an Augmented Reality Escape Game Promotes Learning About Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we focus on Escape Fake , an augmented reality (AR) escape game developed for use in media literacy education.
judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted a field study using a pretest-posttest research design. A total of 28 students (14 girls, mean age = 14.71 years) participated.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré-teste/pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) para letramento midiático, alinhado ao tema. O método e o achado principal estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Design and analysis of personalized serious games for information literacy: catering to introverted and extraverted individuals through game elements

judge.evidence_topic: This paper delves into a study on a personalized serious game that utilizes suitable game elements tailored to students’ personality traits, focusing on the dimensions of introversion and extraversion. To evaluate the impact of personalized serious games, a comparative experiment was conducted. The study involved both a Control group (Non-personalized game-based approach) and an Experimental group (Personalized game-based approach). Participants were assessed using pre-post tests measuring knowledge acquisition and retention in information literacy for source evaluation
judge.evidence_empirical: To evaluate the impact of personalized serious games, a comparative experiment was conducted. The study involved both a Control group (Non-personalized game-based approach) and an Experimental group (Personalized game-based approach). Participants were assessed using pre-post tests measuring knowledge acquisition and retention in information literacy for source evaluation, as well as intrinsic motivation measured through the IMI questionnaire.
judge.reason: O artigo trata de jogos sérios para letramento informacional (avaliação de fontes), o que se enquadra no tema de combate à desinformação. O estudo é empírico (experimento comparativo) e o achado extraído reflete corretamente os resultados apresentados no resumo.

O tema (desinformação sobre crise de refugiados) não está entre as exclusões do pedido, e o achado principal é sustentado diretamente pelo resumo.

Learning to Evaluate (Mis)information in an Online Game: Strategies Matter!

judge.evidence_empirical: The participants were 132 8th and 9th-grade students who played different versions of a misinformation game that either simulated evaluation strategies or did not simulate them and either included misinformation explanations or did not include them.

items.title: Inoculation against conspiracy theories: A consumer side approach to India's fake news problem

judge.evidence_topic: We attempt to replicate Roozenbeek and van der Linden's Western‐based study in India by employing the Bad News Game , an online game, in which players take on the role of a misinformation tycoon. They are exposed to weakened doses of the strategies employed in conspiracy and fake news production with the aim to cognitively inoculate them against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We test the game's impact on an Indian sample ( n = 1002) using a within‐subject design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico utilizando o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra desinformação em uma amostra indiana, utilizando um desenho intra-sujeitos. O tema e o método estão alinhados com o pedido, e o achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.
